q: What does this traffic sign mean?
imageDesc: Red circular prohibitory sign with black left-turn arrow crossed by a red slash
info: Left turns are banned here, usually for safety or traffic flow. Turning left disobeys a regulatory sign under RA 4136.

q: What does this traffic sign mean?
imageDesc: Red circular prohibitory sign with black right-turn arrow crossed by a red slash
info: Right turns are banned at this spot. Like all regulatory signs, violating it is an offense under RA 4136.

q: What does this traffic sign mean?
imageDesc: Red circular prohibitory sign with a horn pictogram crossed by a red slash
info: Silent zones (hospitals, schools) ban horn use. Elsewhere the horn is only a crash warning, not for noise.

q: What does this traffic sign mean?
imageDesc: Red circular prohibitory sign with a bicycle pictogram crossed by a red slash
info: Bicycles are banned on this road or lane. Riders must take alternate routes for everyone's safety.

q: What does this traffic sign mean?
imageDesc: Red-circled regulatory sign with black number 30 (no slash)
info: A number in a red circle without a slash sets the maximum speed. Slow to 30 kph or below here.

q: What does this traffic sign mean?
C: Trucks must use the left lane
imageDesc: Red circular prohibitory sign with a truck pictogram crossed by a red slash
info: Trucks are banned on this road, often to protect weak roads or ease congestion. It is regulatory under RA 4136.

q: What does this traffic sign mean?
imageDesc: Red circular prohibitory sign with a black letter P crossed by a red slash
info: Parking is banned here at all times. A brief load/unload stop is allowed only if it does not obstruct others.

q: What does this traffic sign mean?
imageDesc: Blue circular mandatory sign with a white arrow pointing down to the right
info: Blue circular signs give mandatory orders: pass on the right side as the arrow directs.

q: What does this traffic sign mean?
imageDesc: Blue square informative sign with a white walking figure over zebra stripes
info: A marked pedestrian lane is ahead. Slow down and yield; pedestrians have priority at crossings.

q: What does this traffic sign mean?
imageDesc: Blue square informative sign with a white bus pictogram
info: This marks a bus stop or loading zone. Do not block it; stop only to load or unload quickly.

q: What does this traffic sign mean?
imageDesc: Red circular prohibitory sign with a walking figure crossed by a red slash
info: Crossing here is banned for pedestrian safety. Cross only at marked crosswalks or footbridges.

q: What does this traffic sign mean?
imageDesc: Red circular prohibitory sign with a tricycle pictogram crossed by a red slash
info: Tricycles are banned on this road, usually national roads and highways, for speed and safety reasons.

q: What does this traffic sign mean?
imageDesc: Blue circular mandatory sign with a white bicycle pictogram
info: This lane is reserved for bicycles. Motor vehicles must stay out to protect cyclists.

q: What does this traffic sign mean?
imageDesc: Blue square informative sign with a white letter H
info: A hospital is nearby. Drive quietly, avoid horn use, and watch for ambulances and crossing patients.

q: What does this traffic sign mean?
imageDesc: Red-bordered triangular warning sign with a narrowing bridge-deck symbol
info: The bridge ahead narrows. Slow down and yield if another vehicle is already on it.

q: What does this traffic sign mean?
imageDesc: Red-bordered triangular warning sign with a train-front pictogram
info: Tracks are ahead. Slow down, look both ways, and never overtake at the crossing.

q: What does this traffic sign mean?
imageDesc: Red-bordered triangular warning sign with two opposing vertical arrows
info: You are leaving a one-way or divided road. Keep right and expect oncoming traffic.

q: What does this traffic sign mean?
imageDesc: Red-bordered triangular warning sign with two converging road lines
info: Lanes narrow ahead. Slow down, keep position, and merge with care.

q: What does this traffic sign mean?
imageDesc: Red-bordered triangular warning sign with falling rock symbols above a slope line
info: Rocks may fall onto the road, common in mountain cuts. Pass quickly but carefully without stopping.

q: What does this traffic sign mean?
imageDesc: Red-bordered triangular warning sign with a cattle silhouette
info: Animals may cross here, especially in rural areas. Slow down, more so at dawn and night.

q: What does this traffic sign mean?
imageDesc: Red-bordered triangular warning sign with a bump arc symbol
info: Humps are ahead. Slow down to protect your suspension and keep control of the vehicle.

q: What does this traffic sign mean?
imageDesc: Red-bordered triangular warning sign with an arrow pointing down a slope
info: A steep descent is ahead. Shift to a low gear and avoid riding the brakes so they do not overheat.

q: What does this chevron sign tell you?
imageDesc: Yellow rectangular chevron board with bold black arrows pointing right
info: Chevrons mark a sharp curve. Follow the arrow direction and slow down before entering the bend.

q: What does this traffic sign mean?
imageDesc: Red-bordered triangular warning sign with a side road merging from the left
info: Traffic joins from the left. Keep lane, adjust speed, and let merging vehicles in safely.

q: What does this traffic sign mean?
imageDesc: Red-bordered triangular warning sign with circular arrows
info: A roundabout is ahead. Yield to vehicles already inside and enter only when clear.

q: What does this traffic sign mean?
imageDesc: Red-bordered triangular warning sign with a walking figure
info: Pedestrians may cross ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop and yield.

q: What does this traffic sign mean?
imageDesc: Red-bordered triangular warning sign with one arrow splitting into two
info: The road divides ahead. Keep to your side and do not cross into oncoming lanes.

q: What does this traffic sign mean?
imageDesc: Red-circled regulatory sign with black text 3.5m
info: Only vehicles lower than 3.5 m may pass under. Taller loads will strike the structure.

q: What does this traffic sign mean?
imageDesc: Red-circled regulatory sign with black text 10t
info: This bridge or road allows at most 10 tons. Overweight vehicles must detour to avoid collapse.

q: What does this traffic sign mean?
imageDesc: Red-bordered triangular warning sign with a 180-degree hairpin arrow
info: An extremely sharp hairpin bend is ahead, common on mountain roads. Slow right down and stay in lane.

q: What does this road sign tell drivers?
imageDesc: Yellow-green rectangular sign with black text SCHOOL SLOW DOWN
info: You are entering a school zone. Slow down, watch for children, and be ready to stop.
